scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env'))fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,red "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
